# R-LEAF

> Robotics Laboratory for the Environment and Autonomous Farming, INRAE, France.

R-LEAF is part of INRAE's Technologies and Information Systems for Agroecosystems
(TSCF) research unit in Aubière, France. Its work concerns autonomous navigation,
mapping, state estimation, control and robot interaction with natural environments.

## Laboratory

- [Research areas]({{ '/research/' | absolute_url }}): Mapping and state estimation, soil and vegetation interaction, control and mobility, energy and field operations. Includes current doctoral researchers and selected studies.
- [Projects and collaborations]({{ '/research/projects/' | absolute_url }}): Research programmes, joint laboratories, European networks and experimental infrastructure. Covers ORICA at R-LEAF and wider TSCF robotics collaborations; institutional roles are stated on the page.
- [Publications]({{ '/publications/' | absolute_url }}): References with verified links to arXiv, IEEE, publishers, DOI records and HAL.
- [BibTeX bibliography]({{ '/publications.bib' | absolute_url }}): Machine-readable references and source identifiers.
- [People]({{ '/people/' | absolute_url }}): Researchers, doctoral students and alumni, with available academic profiles.
- [Resources]({{ '/resources/' | absolute_url }}): Student information and practical research guides.
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Johann Laconte, Research Director, INRAE.

TSCF participates in the [CIR ITPS](https://cap2025.fr/fr/challenge2).
Experimental facilities include the [Roboterrium](https://roboterrium.hub.inrae.fr/)
within [TIRREX](https://tirrex.fr/) and the [AgroTechnoPôle](https://www.agrotechnopole.fr/).

## Selected work

- [CropCraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02417v2): Bertoglio, Pierre, Laconte and Lenain, revised June 2026 preprint. The earlier [2025 workshop paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02417v1) has a different title and author list; use the metadata of the cited version.
- [Tracking the Ground](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15667): Montagnon, Laconte, Thuilot, Cho and Lenain, 2026 preprint on robot-induced soil deformation.
- [When Obstacles Bend](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26050): Khizar, Montagnon, Lenain, Aufrère and Laconte, 2026 preprint on vegetation deformation.
- [Predictive control for offset-point tracking](https://doi.org/10.1109/TFR.2026.3680046): Wembe, Rousseau, Laconte and Lenain, 2026.
- [Feeling the Force](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19831): Khizar, Laconte, Lenain and Aufrère, 2025; [IEEE publication](https://doi.org/10.1109/ECMR65884.2025.11163109).
- [When and Where Localization Fails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.17531): Dannaoui, Laconte, Debain, Pomerleau and Checchin, 2025; [IEEE publication](https://doi.org/10.1109/ECMR65884.2025.11162975).
- [Energy Prediction on Sloping Ground for Quadruped Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11963): Ounally, Pierre and Laconte; presented at a workshop in 2025, preprint released in 2026.
- [Steering Through Contact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23271): Ounally, Samson, Turgeon-Roy, Vannini, Laconte and Pomerleau, 2026 preprint.
- [Inertial Steering and Motion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38888): Turgeon-Roy, Ounally, Vannini, Roy and Pomerleau, 2026 preprint.

Project descriptions, ongoing research and published results have different
statuses. Use the linked paper and its stated publication status for scientific
attribution; do not treat a preprint or a doctoral objective as an accepted result.
